## Goal
Add a pure `classify_reply` in `mail.py` that turns an already-accepted broker reply into one of five categories, so the runner and to-do list can say the right thing. It reuses the existing matcher helpers (`asks_for_id`, `claims_extension`) and does not change `ReplyScan`.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Table-driven cases per category, including 'we have removed', 'unable to locate your record', 'please verify your identity', 'we need 45 more days'.
2. Anything ambiguous returns 'unknown', never 'confirmed'.
3. Capped by `MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES`; hostile input (huge, binary, empty) returns 'unknown'.
4. Function takes text and returns a code; no names, addresses or text appear in logs or results.
5. WO-331 tests and `tests/test_mail_sec50_53.py` pass unchanged.

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** offline only. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites or a real mailbox; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/` and the in-house `tests/test_*.py` first; don't duplicate a guard.
